class.name: IfcObjective
class.brief_description: An IfcObjective captures qualitative information for an objective-based constraint. HISTORY: New Entity in IFC Release 2.0 Use definition IfcObjective is a subtype of IfcConstraint and may be associated with any subtype of IfcRoot through the IfcRelAssociatesConstraint relationship in the IfcControlExtension schema, or may be associated with IfcProperty by IfcPropertyConstraintRelationship .
